title: How big is the open model economy today?
author: Nathan Lambert
description: Our first open model economy research note for paid subscribers.
summary: My longest running agent testbed has been building the Interconnects Dashboard — an aggregator of all of the best data on open model adoption and performance from across the web. This dashboard is freely available and becoming quite useful.
takeaways: Share I’ve been building the best measurements I can here, primarily using the open model inference startups Baseten, Fireworks, and Together AI as the bellwethers here (along with the open model share of OpenRouter’s token volume, which they thankfully report in their API).
We have noisy platform metrics, marketing-related metrics from startups, and imperfect public evaluations.
The primary question I wanted to address today is: What is the market for open model inference?
